frontend-engineer.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
frontend-engineer.summary: Build fast, accessible interfaces used by hundreds of thousands of people.
frontend-engineer.description: You'll own the frontend architecture for our flagship product, working closely with design and backend engineers to ship features end to end.
requirements: Strong eye for interface detail and performance
Comfortable working directly with clients and stakeholders

backend-engineer.title: Backend Engineer
backend-engineer.summary: Design APIs and services that power products used across a dozen countries.
backend-engineer.description: You'll design and maintain the services behind our clients' products, focusing on reliability, data integrity and clean APIs.
requirements: 3+ years with Node.js, Go or a similar backend stack
A pragmatic approach to testing and observability

product-designer.title: Product Designer
product-designer.summary: Shape the end-to-end experience for our clients' most important products.
product-designer.description: You'll work from early discovery through to polished UI, partnering with engineers to make sure nothing is lost in translation.
requirements: A portfolio showing end-to-end product thinking
Fluency in Figma and modern design systems
Experience presenting work directly to clients

account-manager.title: Client Account Manager
account-manager.summary: Be the voice of our clients inside Nexora and keep every engagement on track.
account-manager.description: You'll manage a portfolio of client relationships, translating their goals into clear priorities for the delivery teams.
requirements: 2+ years in account or project management, ideally at an agency
Comfortable juggling multiple projects at once

hero.title: The people behind Nexora
hero.subtitle: A small team of designers, engineers and strategists who've spent their careers building products people actually use.

olena-kravchenko.bio: Olena co-founded Nexora after a decade leading product teams at fast-growing startups.
longBio: Olena sets Nexora's direction and works closely with clients on strategy, from the first conversation through to long-term partnership.
Before Nexora, she spent ten years leading product teams at high-growth startups across Europe, shipping software used by millions of people.
olena-kravchenko.quote: Great products are never an accident — they're the result of a team that cares.

james-carter.bio: James leads engineering at Nexora, setting the technical bar for every product the team ships.
longBio: James makes sure our architecture choices hold up years after launch, and that every engineer on the team has what they need to do their best work.
He spent the earlier part of his career building infrastructure for fintech platforms before co-founding Nexora with Olena in 2014.
james-carter.quote: The best architecture is the one nobody notices, because it just works.

sophie-bauer.bio: Sophie leads Nexora's design practice, from early discovery workshops to polished, shipped interfaces.
longBio: Sophie builds the design systems and processes that let our teams move fast without sacrificing quality or consistency.
She previously led design teams at two European scale-ups, and holds a degree in Interaction Design from the UdK Berlin.
sophie-bauer.quote: Good design is invisible — you only notice it when it's missing.

marco-rossi.bio: Marco designs and builds the backend services behind our clients' most demanding products.
longBio: Marco specializes in data-intensive systems, from payment processing to real-time analytics, and mentors engineers across the team.
He's contributed to several open-source projects in the Node.js ecosystem and speaks regularly at backend engineering meetups.
marco-rossi.quote: Reliable systems are built one boring, well-tested decision at a time.

claire-dubois.bio: Claire builds fast, accessible interfaces and helps set frontend standards across every Nexora project.
longBio: Claire cares deeply about performance and accessibility, and regularly audits client products to make sure they work for everyone.
She previously worked at a Paris-based design agency, building interfaces for retail and media clients.
claire-dubois.quote: An interface isn't finished until it works for every single user.

daniel-garcia.bio: Daniel is the first point of contact for our clients, keeping every engagement on track from kickoff to launch.
longBio: Daniel translates client goals into clear priorities for our delivery teams, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.
He's managed client relationships in the agency world for over eight years, across industries from retail to healthcare.
daniel-garcia.quote: The best partnerships are built on clear communication, not just good work.
